key.name: rows
key.summary: Rows per page in an app folder popup
key.description: Upstream GNOME hardcodes this value to 3, which is also the lower bound here. Rows times columns is the capacity of one page; the popup height follows from it the same way and is likewise capped by the screen.

key.name: columns
key.summary: Columns per page in an app folder popup
key.description: Upstream GNOME hardcodes this value to 3, which is also the lower bound here. The extension re-splits the pages of every folder after a change, because GNOME itself only paginates while icons are added or removed - changing the column count alone would not reflow anything. The popup width follows from this value (columns times the 147px cell, plus spacings and margin) and is capped by the screen: when a full row does not fit, every folder's cell shrinks together instead of drawing columns outside the popup.
